description: Search HeadStart's tech jobs. `query` is the role only ('backend engineer at a climate startup'); years, pay, place and dates have their own fields. `query` ranks but never narrows the total; `keyword` requires a word. For visas or relocation use `work_authorization`, never `keyword`. Text `company` matches any name containing it: say so. Non-tech is left out unless `include_non_tech`.

company.description: Text in a company's name, or a Board key ('ashby:openai'); a key or exact name with `category`.

country.description: ISO code (US, GB) or English name ('Germany').

detail.description: full adds counts per filter and country (slow).

employment_type.description: full-time also keeps jobs stating none.

exclude_company.description: Skips companies whose name has this.

first_seen_within_hours.description: First seen within this many hours.

include_non_tech.description: Also keep jobs confidently not tech.

india_place.description: An Indian city or region ('pune'), or 'india'.

keyword.description: Words the job must contain, as word starts; quotes keep a phrase.

location.description: Text in the location; Zurich finds Zürich.

max_age_days.description: Skips postings older than this; 0: any age.

max_years.description: The user's years ('3+' is 3); keeps jobs stating none.

operators.description: Who may post; staffing and aggregator need naming or `company`.

per_company.description: Most rows a company (3; 0: no cap).

query.description: The role only; omit for the newest.

required_years_at_least.description: Jobs asking at least this many years.

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217, such as USD or INR.

salary_max.description: Annual; keeps ranges starting at or under it.

salary_min.description: Annual (30 lakh = 3000000); keeps ranges reaching it.

similar_to.description: A job id to rank by, not with `query`.

work_authorization.description: As the description says, by HeadStart's rules; confirm with get_job.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
